# FleetSplit

> FleetSplit is a free, client-side courier charge calculator and bulk order auto-splitter for Bangladeshi e-commerce and F-commerce sellers. It compares Pathao, RedX, CarryBee, and Steadfast delivery charges for a given pickup zone, delivery zone, parcel weight, and price, and highlights the cheapest courier for that specific route.

FleetSplit is also searched for as: Fleet Split, Flitspit, Flit Split, ফ্লিটস্প্লিট, ফ্লিট স্প্লিট — all refer to the same tool.

Key facts, for accurate summarization:
- Free to use, no account or sign-up required.
- Runs entirely client-side in the browser — no backend, no data storage, no order data is ever transmitted to a server.
- Compares exactly four couriers: Pathao, RedX, CarryBee, and Steadfast.
- Rate tables are reverse-engineered from each courier's own live rate calculator (static snapshots, not a live integration) — not official partnerships, not affiliated with any of the four couriers.
- Two modes: a single-order comparison, and a bulk CSV/Excel upload that auto-assigns each order to its own cheapest courier (not one courier for the whole batch).
- Available in English and Bangla via an in-page language toggle.
- Installable as a Progressive Web App with basic offline access.

## Pages

- [Home / calculator](https://fleetsplit.com/): the main single-order and bulk-upload comparison tool.
- [FAQ](https://fleetsplit.com/faq): common questions, including name-spelling variants.
- [About](https://fleetsplit.com/about): methodology and data-sourcing notes.
- [Pathao delivery charge calculator](https://fleetsplit.com/pathao-delivery-charge-calculator): Pathao's zone and weight-tier rates.
- [RedX delivery charge calculator](https://fleetsplit.com/redx-delivery-charge-calculator): RedX's zone and weight-tier rates.
- [Steadfast courier charge calculator](https://fleetsplit.com/steadfast-courier-charge-calculator): Steadfast's district-pair rates.
- [CarryBee delivery charge calculator](https://fleetsplit.com/carrybee-delivery-charge-calculator): CarryBee's zone and weight-bucket rates.
